name: @thewuwacalculator/leaderboard
description: Leaderboard service for card intake, reading, scoring and boards.

scripts.dev:full: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; node tools/dev-scorer-config.mjs || exit 1; npm run --silent migrate:user || exit 1; node tools/local-scorer.mjs & node tools/dev-sweep.mjs & node tools/dev-wrangler.mjs -c wrangler.jsonc -c wrangler.scorer.dev.jsonc --port 8787 --local --persist-to .wrangler/user-state --test-scheduled
scripts.migrate:user: wrangler d1 migrations apply LB --local -c wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/user-state
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply LB --local -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply LB --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
